title: HSK 1 · Foundations
subtitle: Beginner
description: The starting point: pinyin, tones, first characters, and essential structures to introduce yourself and handle basic situations.
objectives: Master the pinyin system: initials, finals, and syllables
Distinguish and produce the four tones and the neutral tone
Introduce yourself and greet naturally
Count, say dates, and ask prices
Talk about your family and your routine
Read and write your first 50 characters
Understand the basic Chinese sentence order

title: HSK 2 · Daily Communication
subtitle: Basic
description: Expand your conversation skills: past and experience, comparisons, shopping, transportation, and plans.
objectives: Narrate past actions with 了 and 过
Compare with 比 and express preferences
Shop, order in restaurants, and get around the city
Talk about plans, weather, and climate
Reach 300 words and 150 characters

title: HSK 3 · Autonomy
subtitle: Intermediate
description: Complex structures (把, resultative and directional complements), extended conversations, and first readings without pinyin.
objectives: Master 把, 是…的, and resultative complements
Hold conversations lasting several minutes
Read adapted texts without pinyin
Write short connected texts
Reach 600 words and 300 characters

title: HSK 4 · Functional Fluency
subtitle: Upper Intermediate
description: Professional vocabulary, formal and informal register nuances, video comprehension, and structured written expression.
objectives: Discuss abstract topics with advanced connectors
Understand audio at near-native speed
Distinguish formal and informal registers
Write emails and simple argumentative texts
Reach 1,200 words

title: HSK 5 · Advanced Competence
subtitle: Advanced
description: Adapted press reading, debates, presentations, and first chengyu. Chinese is no longer an obstacle.
objectives: Read adapted newspaper articles
Debate and argue with fluency
Use chengyu and common idiomatic expressions
Write texts of 400+ characters
Reach 2,500 words

title: HSK 6 · Mastery
subtitle: Upper Advanced
description: Adapted literature, academic and business language, understanding native speakers at real speed.
objectives: Understand natives at natural speed
Read literature and general press
Negotiate and present in professional settings
Write complex formal texts
Reach 5,000 words

title: HSK 7-9 · Professional Mastery
subtitle: Mastery
description: The level for those who work, research, or fully live in Chinese: nuance, rhetoric, deep culture, and native precision.
objectives: Express yourself with precision and nuance in any context
Master academic, technical, and literary language
Understand standard dialects and regional variants of the standard
Produce high-level professional texts

title: TOCFL Novice 1 · Getting Started
subtitle: Taiwan Mandarin Beginner
description: Begin your journey with Taiwan's official Chinese proficiency test. Learn greetings, numbers, and basic expressions in Traditional characters.
objectives: Greet and introduce yourself in Taiwan Mandarin
Use basic numbers and time expressions
Understand and use common Taiwan-specific vocabulary
Introduce family members and occupations
Read and write basic Traditional Chinese characters
Order food and ask simple prices

title: TOCFL Novice 2 · Daily Life in Taiwan
subtitle: Taiwan Mandarin Elementary
description: Navigate daily situations in Taiwan: transportation, weather, shopping, and dining with appropriate politeness levels.
objectives: Ask for and give directions using Taiwan place names
Talk about weather and seasons in Taiwan
Shop at night markets and traditional markets
Order food and make simple requests politely
Use Taiwan-specific measure words and particles
Describe daily routines and simple plans
